title: 1700 Beats WCM
transcript: This is me, a 1700 rated player, and this is my opponent, streamer Alexandra Prado, and a WCM. As usual, I start with a London system, and she doesn't seem too happy to see this. We had played a friendly game in this line before, and it had gone well for her, but for some reason she decides to change her repertoire, and now I'm actually just slightly better. I decide to start an attack. I bring my bishop to the king side, and I remove the knight, one of the key defenders of the position. After this, my queen comes in and threatens to pick up the pawn on the edge, and I'm Fortunately, G6 [music] stop anything because here I spot this idea. I sacrifice my knight first, >> [music] >> and after she takes back with one of the pawns, I am going to sacrifice my bishop too. And now the position is completely shred open. My queen is right in front of her king. I'm going to pick up the bishop back, and I'm actually just winning. But because Alexandra is such a strong player, she actually manages to bring her king to safety, and after a while, she's the one calling the shots. But unfortunately, she loses on time. And so, just like that, I got my second ever titled win.
